request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MARKET

layers.text: Remove all ground: erase the brown dirt ground and the wooden floor under the tent, so the tent posts, crates and barrel stand directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under them. Repaint the brown crates, barrel and posts in pale straw-yellow birch wood. Keep the red and cream striped tent, the red pennant, the yellow and green goods, outline and art style exactly the same.
